summary: Explored kamod-charts reference primitives (ReferenceLine/Area/Point), cartesian type definitions, geometry helpers, chart layering order across Line/Area/Bar/Scatter, export barrels, existing tests, and plot clipping strategy. ScatterChart currently supports referenceLines only (below scatter series); it lacks referenceAreas/referencePoints props and does not forward strokeWidth/strokeDasharray to ReferenceLine unlike LineChart.
current_status: Reference system is mature for LineChart (full trio) and BarChart (lines + areas); AreaChart has lines only; ScatterChart has partial referenceLines support. No SVG clipPath—plot bounds enforced via geometry clamping for areas/points.
